controls.control: Inbound request body and framing limit
controls.evidence: ASGI request bodies are bounded by MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES and malformed content length takes an explicit rejection path.
Streaming provider responses enforce Content-Length and chunked byte ceilings before parsing JSON/XML or analysis output.

controls.control: SSRF URL syntax and DNS/IP destination policy
controls.evidence: Webhook URLs reject credentials, fragments, local/metadata/reserved IPs and unsafe DNS answers; exact allowlists are explicit.

controls.control: Outbound HTTP timeout and redirect boundary
controls.evidence: User-configurable delivery and connector clients use bounded timeouts and do not follow redirects; HTTP status failures remain retryable/permanent failures.

controls.control: XML DTD and external entity rejection
controls.evidence: Feed and Trends XML inputs reject DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations before ElementTree parsing and reject malformed XML explicitly.

controls.control: Provider JSON/body validation and error translation
controls.evidence: Non-object provider JSON, provider error bodies, non-2xx responses and oversized analysis responses are converted into explicit failures.
Persisted evidence URLs remove sensitive query parameters and raw payloads are sanitized before storage.
Production settings enforce HTTPS for external analysis/SMTP where required, bound timeouts, reject malformed allowlists and disallow unsafe URL syntax.
